study type: Planned secondary analysis of a prospective cohort study
exposure: Proactive coping (measured by Proactive Coping Scale)
outcome: Composite adverse perinatal outcomes (unplanned cesarean delivery, gestational diabetes, hypertensive disorders of pregnancy)
finding: Lower early pregnancy proactive coping scores are associated with a significant increase in adverse perinatal outcomes.
mod_finding: This study found that lower proactive coping scores in early pregnancy were associated with a higher risk of unplanned cesarean delivery, but did not examine other modes of delivery.
